title: Halting reduces to the game value: the MIP* = RE target assembled from four blueprint lemmas
intent: Prove the project's headline node thm:main (halting reduces to the synchronous game value, the formalization target of MIP* = RE) whose proof is pure glue: apply the conditional lemma halting_reduces_to_gameValue_of and discharge its two inputs -- a GapCompression and a universal machine -- from four named blueprint lemmas, so the theorem is one hole per stage.

parent.name: thm:main
parent.statement: Halting reduces to the game value (Theorem 12.2 of JNVWY20, synchronous form): there is a computable map g from Turing machines to game descriptions such that, for every Turing machine M, (Completeness) if M halts on the empty input then the synchronous value of the game g(M) is 1, and (Soundness) if M does not halt on the empty input then the synchronous value of g(M) is at most 1/2.
parent.note: A blueprint node marked \leanok and proved in Lean. Its proof (the glue) is a list of citations: it applies the conditional halting_reduces_to_gameValue_of, supplying a GapCompression (Theorem thm:compression-target) and a universal machine.

children.name: thm:halting
children.statement: Assume an ambient MIPRE.GapCompression. There is a computable map from Turing machines to explicit synchronous game descriptions such that: if M halts on the empty input then the game of M has a value-1 PCC strategy (so its synchronous and quantum values are both 1), and if M does not halt then its quantum value is at most 1/2 (hence its synchronous value too, by Lemma lem:sync-le-valstar). Moreover the reduction is polynomial-time.
children.note: Supplies the reduction the main theorem instantiates. Its proof (L7415-L7425) derives halting_reduction_of and halting_reduces_to_gameValue_of from Theorem thm:compression, through Lemma lem:compressible-criterion at the classes of Remark rem:compression-abstract, discharging the four obligations via exists_obligations.

children.name: cor:compression-from-answer-reduction
children.statement: From an inhabitant of MIPRE.AnswerReduction 5 alone there is a MIPRE.GapCompression, and consequently thm:main, cor:main-quantum, cor:value-uncomputable and thm:mipstar-eq-re hold with no other hypothesis.
children.note: Assembles the three stages (introspection, answer reduction, parallel repetition) plus a universal machine into a GapCompression. Its \uses{} is thm:compression,lem:introspection-supply,thm:parallel-repetition,lem:universal-tm; its proof applies thm:compression to those three supplied stages and reads off the chapter-7 consequences via cor:halting-consequences.

children.name: thm:answer-reduction
children.statement: In the source model there is a polynomial-time Turing machine that, on input a level-ell normal form verifier with a standard timeout-counter decider, outputs a higher-level normal form verifier satisfying completeness (a value-1 PCC strategy on the input transfers to the output) and soundness (if the output value exceeds 1-eps then the input value is at least 1-delta(eps,n)).
children.note: One of the three compression stages. Its proof (L6058-L6063) reads: 'In the ambient form of Definition def:answer-reduction-contract, at ell=5, this is Lemma lem:answer-reduction-supply.'

children.name: thm:compression-target
children.note: Removes the remaining hypothesis: its proof supplies the compression the main theorem's glue asks for, applying cor:compression-from-answer-reduction at the answer reduction of lem:answer-reduction-supply.

applicability.goal_shape: A headline theorem of the form 'there is a computable map with a completeness clause and a soundness clause', whose proof is the instantiation of a conditional lemma (one taking a hypothesis or contract such as GapCompression) at a named supply of that hypothesis.
applicability.use_when: The theorem is a node of a published dependency graph (a blueprint \uses{} node) and each named dependency is itself a node with its own proof, so the glue is a list of citations and every bit of difficulty lives in the children, one hole per bounded prover.
applicability.avoid_when: The glue itself carries mathematical content that must be proved rather than cited; or the dependencies are not named statements, so the one-hole-per-lemma shape does not arise.

consequences: The glue creates no proof obligation of its own beyond the citations: it inherits whatever inputs the cited conditional lemma asks for (here a GapCompression, discharged by thm:compression-target, and a universal machine, discharged inside the compression assembly). Because every node is \leanok and the Lean proof is a one-line application, a wrong or too-weak child would surface as a type error rather than a silent gap; but the node's own proof defers all difficulty to the children, each of which is itself a large node with its own \uses{} cone. The assembly is brittle in the sense that it records a fixed choice of stages (introspection, the classical-PCP answer reduction, repetition, the self-universal machine); changing any stage means changing the cited supply, not the glue.
